globalThis.comparison=(()=>{
 const checks={},v=Number(globalThis.variant)||0,w=300+v,near=(a,b)=>Math.abs(a-b)<.01;
 const sheet=document.createElement('style');sheet.textContent='html,body{margin:0;padding:0}div{margin:0;padding:0;border:0;box-sizing:content-box}';document.head.append(sheet);
 const box=(parent,css,attrs={})=>{const n=document.createElement('div');n.style.cssText=css;for(const [k,value] of Object.entries(attrs))n.setAttribute(k,value);parent.append(n);return n;};
 const rect=(n)=>n.getBoundingClientRect();
 let p=box(document.body,'width:'+w+'px',{dir:'rtl'}),c=box(p,'width:100px;height:10px');
 checks.blockEnd=near(rect(c).x,w-100)&&near(rect(c).right,w);
 checks.computed=getComputedStyle(p).direction==='rtl'&&getComputedStyle(c).direction==='rtl';
 c.style.marginInlineStart='10px';checks.marginStart=near(rect(c).right,w-10);
 checks.resolvedStart=getComputedStyle(c).marginInlineStart==='10px'&&getComputedStyle(c).marginRight==='10px';
 c.style.cssText='width:100px;height:10px;margin-left:7px';checks.physicalLeft=near(rect(c).right,w);
 p.style.paddingInlineStart='20px';c.style.cssText='width:100px;height:10px';checks.paddingStart=near(rect(c).right,w);checks.paddingWidth=near(rect(p).width,w+20);
 p.style.paddingInlineStart='';p.style.borderInlineStart='5px solid';checks.borderStart=near(rect(c).right,w)&&near(rect(p).width,w+5)&&near(rect(p).right,w+5);
 p.style.borderInlineStart='';p.dir='ltr';checks.mutationLtr=near(rect(c).x,0)&&getComputedStyle(c).direction==='ltr';
 p.dir='rtl';checks.mutationRtl=near(rect(c).x,w-100);
 c.style.direction='ltr';const g=box(c,'width:40px;height:4px');checks.authorOverride=near(rect(g).x,w-100)&&getComputedStyle(c).direction==='ltr';
 p.remove();
 p=box(document.body,'display:flex;width:'+w+'px',{dir:'rtl'});let a=box(p,'width:50px;height:10px'),b=box(p,'width:60px;height:10px');
 checks.flexRow=near(rect(a).right,w)&&near(rect(b).right,w-50);
 p.style.justifyContent='flex-end';checks.flexEnd=near(rect(b).x,0)&&near(rect(a).x,60);
 p.remove();
 p=box(document.body,'display:grid;grid-template-columns:100px 80px;width:'+w+'px;direction:rtl');a=box(p,'height:10px');b=box(p,'height:10px');
 checks.gridColumns=near(rect(a).right,w)&&near(rect(b).right,w-100)&&near(rect(b).width,80);
 p.remove();
 p=box(document.body,'position:relative;width:'+w+'px;height:40px;direction:rtl');a=box(p,'position:absolute;width:30px;height:10px;inset-inline-start:10px');
 checks.insetStart=near(rect(a).right,w-10);
 a.style.insetInlineStart='';a.style.insetInlineEnd='4px';checks.insetEnd=near(rect(a).x,4);
 p.remove();
 p=box(document.body,'width:'+w+'px',{dir:'auto'});c=box(p,'width:100px;height:10px');
 checks.autoNoStrong=near(rect(c).x,0)&&getComputedStyle(p).direction==='ltr';
 p.remove();
 p=box(document.body,'width:'+w+'px',{dir:'bogus'});c=box(p,'width:100px;height:10px');
 checks.invalidInherits=near(rect(c).x,0)&&getComputedStyle(p).direction==='ltr';
 p.remove();
 p=box(document.body,'width:'+w+'px');c=box(p,'width:100px;height:10px;margin-inline-start:10px');
 checks.ltrControl=near(rect(c).x,10);
 p.remove();
 return checks;
})()
